tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /sbyor ba yan lag drug gi ngo sprod sbas don gsal ba'i sgron ma bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru bh+yaḥn mo badz+ra sat+ta ya/na mo mahā mu tre pā ra ma aka
༄༅/ /sbyor ba yan lag drug gi ngo sprod sbas don gsal ba'i sgron ma bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru bh+yaḥn mo badz+ra sat+ta ya/na mo mahā mu tre pā ra ma aka

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sbyor ba yan lag drug gi ngo sprod sbas don gsal ba'i sgron ma bzhugs so// na mo gu ru bh+yaḥn mo badz+ra sat+ta ya/ na mo mahā mu tre pā ra ma ak+ṣa ra mahā su khā ya/ rgyud thams cad kyi nges don rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi ngo sprod sbas don gsal ba'i sgron ma zhes bya ba/ bla ma dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag rgya chen po 'gyur med bde ba chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mngon 'dus ma byas ye shes kyis dag dbyibs kyi sku/ /smon pa med pa'i ye shes kyis dag gsang sngags sgra/ /mtshan med stong nyid ye shes kyis dag chos sku dang / /lhan cig skyes pa'i sku bzhi dbyer med bla mar 'dud/ /phra rab rdul spangs sna tshogs gzugs can ma/ /rmi lam sgyu ma pra phab rang bzhin can/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi bskyed mdzad ma/ /rnam pa kun mchog phyag rgya chen mor 'dud/ /stong nyid mchog gi chu gter che las byung / /zag med yon tan mtha' yas dpal 'bar ba/ /rdzogs sangs sras bcas ded dpon dam pas blangs/ /kun gyi gtsug rgyan bde mchog nor bur 'dud/ /rgyal ba sras bcas kun gyi lam gcig pu/ /mtha' yas rgyud sde kun gyi sbas pa'i bcud/ /rnam dpyod man ngag bral bas ma myangs pa/ /rgyud 'grel man ngag ji bzhin legs bstan gyis/ /nges don la gus khengs pa rnam bral zhing / /bdag gzhan thar 'dod don gnyer sgrub la brtson/ /bla ma la gus ltos med bzhi ldan dag /rin chen rin thang med pa 'di long zhig /'dir rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi nyams len rgyud las byung ba ltar bla mas bstan cing slob mas nyams su blangs pas/ nyams myong phyin ci ma log pa rgyud la skyes pa ngo shes shing yid ches la/ mos pa gzhan gyis dbrog par mi nus shing mthar phyin par bskyang par bya ba'i don du rgyud 'grel dang man ngag zab mo rnams kyis ngo sprod par byed pa la/ ji ltar bshad cing mnyan pa'i tshul dang /

tshul des ji ltar ngo sprod pa gnyis kyis dang po ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis mdo rgyud zab cing rgya che ba rnams ji ltar gsungs pa'i tshul dang mthun par phun tshogs lnga gtab pa'i sgo nas nyan bshad mdzad pa bka' srol du gda' bas/ gnas phun sum tshogs pa rtsa rgyud gsungs pa'i gnas dpal ldan 'bras phung gi mchod rten gyi phyi rol du rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad dag pas ka ba nyi shu rtsa brgyad btsugs pa/ 'og tu chos kyi dbyings gsung gi dbang phyug gi dkyil 'khor sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi bdag nyid stong pa dang snying rje bcu drug dag pa'i cha bcu drug gi bdag nyid can dang / steng du rgyu skar gyi chu tshod dag pa'i dpal ldan rgyu skar gyi dkyil 'khor rigs drug rnam par dag pa'i cha drug gi rnam par dbye ba can/ ston pa phun tshogs sprul pa'i sku shākya thub pa'am dus kyi 'khor lo/ 'khor phun tshogs sdud pa po rgyal po zla ba bzang pos thog mdzad pa lha dang lha ma yin la sogs pa/ dus phun sum tshogs nag pa'i nya/ chos phun tshogs dang po'i sangs rgyas kyi brjod bya'i gtso bo thabs rgyud rdo rje'i rnal 'byor rnam pa bzhi thos shing nyams su blangs pa las/ dgos pa'i dgos pa phun tshogs rgyu rgyud rigs gsum lnga drug gi dri ma ma lus pa dag nas/ 'bras rgyud bde stong dbyer med rdo rje sems dpa' mngon du gyur snyam pa'am/ yang na gnas rnam kun tu stong pa dag pa'i rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga dbyibs gru gsum chos 'byung gi rang bzhin rtsa ba thur la zug cing gdengs ka gyen du phyogs pa'i nang du bdud dang bgegs dang mi mthun pa'i phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo 'og thams cad rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje'i rwa ba dang drwa ba/ steng rdo rje'i gur/ 'og tu mdung / steng du mda'i drwa bas spras pa'i phyi rol du bskal ba 'jig pa'i me lta bu'i me dpung rab tu 'bar bas bskor ba'i nang du 'jig rten gyi khams dag pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su/

ston pa rigs drug pa dus kyi 'khor lo'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs pa/ 'khor rang me tog gang phog gi lhar dmigs pas thog drangs pa'i gshegs pa gshegs ma/ sems dpa' sems ma/ khro bo khro mo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ chos zung 'jug bde ba chen po/ dus bzang ngan bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsum gyi bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dus su dran pas bskyed rim pa yin na bskyed rim/ rdzogs rim pa yin na rdzogs rim gyi ngang nas gsan par bgyi/ gnyis pa la yid ches bskyed pa'i phyir brgyud pa'i lo rgyus dang / de las brgyud pa'i gdams pa dngos gnyis kyi/ dang po ni/ rtsa rgyud du/ bya rgod phung po'i ri chen por/ /theg pa chen po bla na med/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i tshul/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams la bstan/ /de nas gcig tu mchod rten cher/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /byang chub sems dpa' sogs rnams kyis/ /thabs gcig de bzhin gshegs pa bzhugs/ /nam mkha' bem min shin tu dang / /go skabs med par rab tu gsal/ /sna tshogs rdo rje'i khang pa gnas/ /chos kyi dbyings dang yid 'ong bar/ /rgyud bstan skyes bu rnams kyis ni/ /bsod nams ye shes dgos pa 'o/ /zhes pa ltar bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa sangs rgyas te chos 'khor bskor theg pa gsum gsungs pa'i rjes su/ bya rgod phung por sher phyin theg chen thun mong gi 'khor la bstan nas mthar 'bras phung gi mchod rten gyi nang steng 'og tu rgyang grags gcig lhag pa'i dpag tshad drug yod par 'og tu chos dbyings gsung dbang gi dkyil 'khor dang / steng du dpal ldan rgyu skar gyi dkyil 'khor spros te der spyir gsang sngags mang po dang / khyad par dus kyi 'khor lo'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs pas 'khor sangs rgyas byang sems khro bo lha klu lha mo'i tshogs dang / rgyal po dgu bcu rtsa drug la sogs pa skal ba dang ldan pa'i gdul bya rnams la/

zhu ba po rgyal po zla bzang gis gsol ba btab pa las/ nag pa'i nya la 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dbang byin te lha dang lha min sogs sangs rgyas su lung bstan nas rtsa rgyud dang po'i sangs rgyas gsungs pa zla bzang gis bsdus te 'grel pa stong phrag drug cu pa mdzad/ rgyud bstan nas lo gnyis pa la zla bzang mya ngan las 'das/ de rjes lha dbang / gzi brjid/ zla bas byin/ lha'i dbang phyug sna tshogs gzugs/ lha'i dbang ldan grags pa rnams kyis rgyal srid bzung ste lo brgya brgyar rtsa rgyud bstan/ de nas nyi ma'i shing rta la sogs pa drang srong rnams rigs sad par mdzad de/ zla bzangs kyis bzhengs pa'i dkyil 'khor du nag nya la drang srong rnams la dbang bskur/ bsdud rgyud phreng ba 'dzin pa'i sdeb sbyor can gyi tshigs bcad stong sum cu pa mdzad/ sa ga'i nya la drang srong rnams kyis phyag chen gyi dngos grub thob/ de nas lo brgyar bsdus rgyud bstun/ pad dkar la rgyud yi ger 'god pa dang / 'grel bshad rtsom par bkos nas mya ngan las 'das te/ bsdus rgyud du/ rdzogs ldan mtshams su kla klo'i chos rnams mtha' dag srid pa gsum gyi bla ma dag gis bcad byas te/ bcad nas lo ni brgyad brgya rnams su tshangs pa bzhag pa mdzad nas bde ba'i gnas su 'gro bar 'gyur/ zhes pas so/ /de bzhin du/ pad dkar gyis kyang 'grel bshad stong phrag bcu gnyis pa mdzad/ lo drug cur rgyal srid bzung / chos bstan/ de ltar bzang po/ rnam rgyal/ bshes gnyen bzang po/ phyag dmar/ khyab 'jug sbas pa/ nyi ma grags/ shin tu bzang / rgya mtsho rnam rgyal/ rgyal dka'/ nyi ma/ sna tshogs gzugs/ zla ba'i 'od/ mtha' yas/ sa skyong / dpal skyong / seng ge rnam gnon/ stobs po che/ ma 'gags pa/ mi'i seng ge dbang phyug chen po/ mtha' yas/ rnam rgyal rnams kyis kyang lo drug cu drug cur rgyal srid bzung nas chos bstan te/ tshangs pa sogs la mi rnams la ni brgya phrag bco brgyad dang ldan 'di dag mi rnams dag gi tshe/

/de yi phyed ni 'od srung gyi'o rab mchog sa yi steng du dpal ldan mi yi seng ge phyed/ /drug cus dman pa de bzhin nyid du dus bzhi so so'i dus su mi thung sogs la 'phrog byed kyi/ /rigs ldan mthar ni ji srid brgya phrag gcig gi lo yi grangs kyi skye bo'i tshe ru rab tu 'gyur/ /zhes pas so/ /de nas drag pos lo brgyar kla klo'i chos rgyun bcad/ de nas lo lnga bcu na mya ngan las 'da'/ de dus rdzogs ldan gyi mgo zug nas lo lnga bcu song ste/ gong gi lung dang / kla klo'i tshogs ni 'khor gyi skye bo dang bcas rab tu bcad nas mi yi lo ni brgya phyed na/ /rigs ldan grub par 'gyur te lha yis bkod pa'i pho brang mtho ba kai lā sha yi rgyab tu 'o/ /zhes pas so/ /de ltar na rigs ldan nyi shu rtsa drug shākya'i rigs kyi rgyal po bdun te sprul pa'i rgyal po sum cu rtsa gsum te/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis gdan gyi mthar ni lha min dgra bo tshe lo brgya pa phyag na 'khor lor 'gyur/ /zhes pas so/ /mkhan chen thar pa ba/ rgyal po thams cad kyis lo brgya brgya chos bstan par bzhed do/ /de dag thams cad kyang byang sems dang khro bos sprul pa ste/ rtsa rgyud du/ zla ba lha dbang gzi brjid can/ /zla bas byin dang lha dbang phyug /sna tshogs gzugs dang lha dbang ldan/ /grags pa pad dkar rim pas so/ /'das pa'i rgyal po nyi ma'i 'od/ /de ni bgegs dgra'i sprul pa ste/ /phyag na rdo rje zla bzang khyod/ /sa snying gshin rje mthar byed dang / /sgrib pa thams cad rnams sel dang / /rmugs byed khengs byed rim pa ste/ /nam mkha'i snying po 'jam dbyangs dang / /'jig rten mgon po go rim bzhin/ /gshin rje gshed sogs khro bo bcu/ /de bar byang chub sems dpa' gzhan/ /bcu gsum de dag rim pa yis/ /rigs ldan rigs las 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /tshul yang / 'grel par/ de bzhin du rim pa ji lta bar gshin rje mthar byed la sogs pa'i khro bo bcu dang /

sa'i snying po la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' bcu gsum po rnams te/ gshin rje mthar byed la sogs pa'i khro bo'i rgyal po de dag gi bar bar du byang chub sems dpa' bcu gsum po rnams lung bstan zhes pa ltar/ gshin rje mthar byed/ sa snying / rmugs byed/ sgrib sel/ khengs byed/ mkha' snying / bgegs dgra/ phyag rdor/ yang gshin rje mthar byed la sogs pa'i sprul pa'o/ /de nas ji ltar brgyud pa'i tshul la 'bro pa'i lugs kyis/ dpal skyong gi sprul pa gcig gis dus zhabs pa la gnang ste sgrub pa mdzad pas chu la mi 'bying pa dang / rkang mgyogs dang / mngon shes lnga sogs thun mong gi grub pa mnyes mthar spyod pa mdzad pas lus ma spangs par mchog thob/ de la dus zhabs chung ngus gsan/ tso'u pa'i nags tshal du bsgoms pas bsgoms ma thag song gzugs mthong ste sgrol ma'i lha tshogs dang / rnam snang gang chen mtsho'i zhal gzigs/ des chos bstan pa thos nas sbyor drug gi man ngag mdzad/ mthar phyag chen gyi dngos grub brnyes te/ mngon shes dang dbang phyug gi yon tan brgyad la sogs pa mngon du gyur skad do/ /des kha che zla mgon la gnang / khong gis dbang mdor bstan gyi dpe gzigs pas/ shin tu mos te gsan pa la ma ga dhar byon/ dus zhabs pa chung ngu yab sras dang mjal/ byang chub sems dpa'i chos skor rnams zhus/ byin rlabs che ba/ rdzogs rim la gus pa/ byang sems 'chings pa'i yon tan mnga' ba'o/ /khong bod du byon pa la grab sgom dkon mchog srung gis zhus te/ khong rang gi 'byor pa thams cad bsdus pas gser srang drug byung ba phul/ dar yug ske la btags te lus phul nas zhabs tog mdzad/ ji ltar gsung ba bzhin bsgrubs pas gdams ngag ma lus pa gnang / sgrub pa kho na gtso bor mdzad pas yi dam lha'i zhal gzigs/ rdzogs rim gyi ye shes nang rtags dang bcas pa mthar phyin pa mnga'o/ /des snor bzangs kyi sgro ston gnam la brtsegs la gnang ste/

paṇ+ḍi ta rgya gar du gshegs pa'i shul du lo gsum dang / yer par lo gsum go bteg mdzad de zhus pas gdams ngag ma lus pa gnang ngo / /de'i slob ma'i mchog yu mo yab sras te/ yab sngags la mos pas bde dgyes sogs mang du gsan zhing / khyad par rdor snying 'grel pa gzigs pas shin tu dad de/ kha che zla mgon gyi drung du gsan du byon pas sgro ston dang mjal/ lo bzhir bzhugs nas dbang gzhung gdam ngag thams cad rdzogs par gsan/ 'di dgung lo lnga bcu rtsa lnga'i sras dhar+m+me shwa ra ste sngon gyi bag chags sad pas gzhon nu nas slob gnyer mdzad/ lo sum cu nas sgrub pa gtso bor mdzad de byin rlabs tsam gyis smin pa dang grol ba mang du byung ngo / /de la khang sar pa nam mkha' 'od kyis gsan/ des grub thob se mo che la gnang ste sgrub pa mdzad pas yi dam gyi lha zhal gzigs/ drod rtags thams cad rdzogs/ lcam jo 'bum gyi 'das mchod kyi dus ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo mang po skyes/ sngon dang phyi ma'i skye ba mang po dang / gzhan sems mkhyen pas grub thob tu grags/ khong gi zhal nas chos drug dang sbyor drug don go gcig pas ngas gnyid kyi 'od gsal dang / nyin par ting nge 'dzin gyi 'od gsal gtso bor bskyangs gsungs/ 'dis sor spong btab pa la drod brtags skyes pa 'ba' zhig byung ste/ sbyor drug tshar ba dang dus 'khor gyi chos la shin tu bka' dog par mdzad/ thugs dam gyi dus su dgongs pa gtad pa tsam gyis byin rlabs rang bzhin gyis 'bar ba dang / ting nge 'dzin skyes pa mang du byung / khro los sman mkhar nas spyan drangs te sbyor drug sogs zhus/ mtha' dmag ji ltar yod tshul la sogs pa'i gsung gleng mdzad pa'i tshe/ ma byon gong du dgon pa la sogs pa gzigs pa'i lo rgyus dang / lo tsā ba'i sku tshe'i tshad la sogs pa gsungs pa rnams thog tu phebs te shin tu mos so/ /bla ma 'di pho ba lung du bsnyung ba mi mnga' bar 'od gsal gyi ngang du gshegs te/

sku gdung ring bsrel la sogs pas kyang sems can gyi don mdzad do/ /de la chos rje 'jam gsar gyis gsan te/ de yang lan gcig sku mtshams la bzhugs pa'i tshe/ 'jam dpal gyi zhal gzigs te/ bdag rjes 'dzin gyi bla ma dang gdam ngag sgom gnas sogs gang lags zhus pas/ grong chung du bla ma grub thob la dus 'khor zhus/ des lam bgrod par 'gyur zhes pa'i lung bstan thob/ dge bshes khyung la de'i gtam dris nas sos ka gcig gshegs par bzhud pa'i nub mo lha 'dre mang pos 'od dang gnam rdo skyur ba dang / 'jigs pa'i gzugs ston pa la sogs pa cho 'phrul mi bzad pa byung / lha 'dre yin par mkhyen nas chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid yin pas kho bo la gang byung yang khyad med snyam nas mgur bzhes pa/ dngos grub ster pa'i yi dam dang / /gnod par sems pa'i 'dre gdon gnyis/ /mi bdag la ro mnyam khyad par med/ /lha 'dre gar dga' mar dga' mdzod/ /gnyen po thos bsam sgom gsum dang / /spang bya nyon mongs rnam rtog rnams/ /bdag la ro mnyam khyad par med/ /mnyam bzang ngan gar dga' mar dga' mdzod/ /'khor brgya dang stong gis bskor ba dang / /rang gcig pur gang bder nyal ba gnyis/ /bdag la ro mnyam khyad par med/ /'khor mang nyung gar dga' mar dga' mdzod/ /tshe ring nad med phun tshogs dang / /da lta nyid du 'chi ba gnyis/ /bdag la ro mnyam khyad par med/ /tshe ring thung gar dga' mar dga' mdzod/ /ces sogs kyi mgur bzhes pas zhi/ de nas g.yas rur byon/ gtsang po'i gzhung na tshur yong tsa na mdun gyi nam mkha' thams cad sangs rgyas byang sems kyis gang ba'i snang ba byung / de nas 'phrang chung du bla ma grub thob dang mjal ma thag phyag na rdo rje'i skur gzigs snang ba 'gyur ba'i mos gus byung / mchog dbang dang sbyor drug zhus pas/ zhag gnyis na sor spong dang bsam gtan gyi drod rtags thams cad rdzogs te bla ma dang gdam ngag la yid ches skyes/

sku gshegs pa'i tshe nga lan gcig 'di nas bde ba can du skye/ zhing sbyong / sems can smin par byed ces gsung nas skyang 'dur du sku gshegs so/ /de la bla ma chos sku 'od zer gyis gsan te/ 'di'i yab nyang stod kyi mkhar sum pa ba/ snying ma'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi gdung rabs bcu bdun rgyun ma chad par byung ba'i brgyud grub thob gser sding pa zhes grags pa gzhon nu 'od dang / yum gcung pa brag sna'i mgar btsun ma shes rab rgyan zhes pa/ spyod phyogs gsang 'dus bde bgyes sogs la thos bsam byas pa yab kyi slob ma zhig ste 'di nyid lhums su zhugs pa na yum la gsang 'dus lha so gnyis pho brang du bskyed pa dang / bltams pa na de rnams phyir byung nas spyi dang so so'i mdzad pas zhing sbyong ba sogs kyi rmi lam rmis/ gzhon nu na yab las rtsed thabs su chos gsan pa ji lta ba bzhin thugs su chud de bzlas pas kun ya mtshan du gyur pa dang / skyegs gnas snying pa'i mkhan po chos kyi rin chen las rab tu byung ste mtshan chos kyi 'od zer zhes par btags/ dgung lo bco lnga pa la yab la mnga' ba'i chos thams cad gsan te thugs su chud par mdzad pa la sogs dgung lo nyer bzhi'i bar du gsan sbyong rgya cher mdzad/ de nas chos rje 'jam gsar gyi drung du byon nas chos mang du gsan/ khyad par gru khang du dus 'khor gyi dbang zhus pa'i tshe sa chog gi stangs stabs mdzad pa na/ rdo rje shugs su gzigs nas zhus pas nga rang dang khyed kyi mthong stangs gcig par byung / 'u cag la bgegs kyis mi tshugs gsung / ye shes phab dus saṃ skṛ ta'i skad mang po byung ste gzhan rnams kyis 'jam gsar la zhus pas kha che paṇa chen skye ba 'phos pa'i bag chags sad par 'dug gsung / dkyil 'khor du bcug pa na ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor mngon sum du gzigs te zhus pas/ khyed rang las sad pa'i skyes bu lags mod gsung /

bzhi pa'i gnas skabs su/ gzung 'dzin thams cad rang grol/ mthong snang tshad med pa shar/ bde stong gi ting nge 'dzin rgyud la skyes/ phyis sgom khang du bsgoms pas nyams rtogs 'ur langs pa byung / zhus pas gsal ba rab kyi mthar phyin zin pa lags/ dgas po bka' rgyud kyi bsgom chen gyi snying rus la/ 'u cag gi gdam ngag 'di yod na lung pa grub thob kyis dgang du yod de gsung / de nas gnas rnying pa'i drung du bsnyen rdzogs mdzad de 'dul ba la sogs pa'i chos dpag tu med pa dang / sri'u chung ba lce ston mdo sde seng ge las gsang sngags phyi nang gi chos mang po gsan/ dpyal a mo gha las kyang dpyal lugs kyi skor la sogs pa'i chos mang po dang / sa skya paṇa chen las kyang chos kyi rnam grangs mang po dang / bla ma 'phags pa/ rgwa lo/ sman chung lung pa bsod rgyal sogs las kyang chos mang du gsan te mkhas pa chen por gyur/ snyan pas phyogs kun tu khyab ste 'gro don dpag tu med pa mdzad/ zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs mang po brtsams/ bskyed rim la brten pas gsang 'dus rnam rgyal sogs yi dam mang po zhal gzigs/ ye shes phab pa'i tshe gnam sa ngo mi shes pa'i byin rlabs rang babs su byung / rmi lam rgyu lus la mnga' brnyes/ mnal 'od gsal du 'byongs/ zung 'jug la dbang 'byor pa sogs mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan dpag tu med pa mnga'/ sku tshe mthar phyin pa na gser sdings dge sdings kyi bu slob yon bdag rnams la chos dang zhal brda mang po mdzad/ bya btang du phebs pa na sgom chen rnams la zhal brda mang po gsungs/ gshegs khar thugs bskyed/ bdag 'jug smon lam rgya cher mdzad de phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing grangs med pa dang / khyad par sgrol ma'i zhing mang po gzigs te/ nam mkhar zla ba lta bu la tshom bu so gnyis 'od lngas skor ba 'od zer shin tu mi bzad pa thal byung du gyen la 'gro ba dang /

dri zhim po dang / rol mo sna tshogs kyi sgra dang bcas te nyer dgu'i mtshan phyed na thams cad stong pa 'od gsal don dam pa'i bden pa mngon du mdzad do/ /de la chos rje kun spangs pas gsan te/ g.yas ru byang gi nga phyar du yab rje rigs 'bro rje dbang phyug yum gnyag mo lum me gnyis kyi sras su 'khrungs te dgung lo lnga pa la gnyag tshe ru sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta la thugs bskyed gsan/ bdun pa la 'khyog dbon rdzong pa la dge bsnyen zhus/ 'khyog zhang pa'i drung du slob gnyer mdzad/ khong gi gsung gis/ 'di la rang sor sdod pa'i mi gcig mi 'ong / yang na mar chad dus kyang mi thul ba gcig yong / yang na dge ba'i bshes gnyen sus kyang 'gran du med pa'i bstan pa la phan pa gcig yong gsung nas rjes su bzung / /thugs rab la gnyes nas rab tu 'byung du bcug ste lo dgu pa la/ de nyid kyis mkhan po/ rdzong pas slob dpon mdzad nas mtshan thugs rje brtson 'grus su btags/ mkhan po de nyid la bka' gdams kyi chos skor mang du gsan/ mi rtag pa rgyud la 'khrungs te/ g.yas ru phyi 'brum dgon gsar du lha btsun bsod nams snying pos mkhan po/ ldog lod pa shākya byang chub kyis las slob/ dge bshes bsod nams blo gros kyis gsang ston/ dge bshes rin chen dbang phyug sogs dge slong lnga bcu tsam gyis dad dge mdzad nas bsnyen par rdzogs so/ /de nas mkhan po/ bla ma rgyal 'phags pa/ dge sdings pa/ sangs rgyas 'bum/ shangs pa dkon brtsegs la sogs pa rnams las byams chos nyi shu/ mdzod rtsa 'grel/ 'dul ba'i bskor/ 'dar 'jam dbyangs/ dpyang ston rigs seng bla zur las phar/ mngon/ tshad ma/ brag ram pa dar ma 'od zer las rgyan/ chos mchog yang dge sdings pa/ lha dgon gsar ba/ dbu ma ba ston rgyal rnams la sher phyin/ dbu ma'i skor/ 'chims las mdzod bka' gdams/ bla ma don grub 'od zer/ chos rgyal 'phags pa/ bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa chos sku ba/

khro phu rin po che rnams las sngags mtshan nyid kyi chos skor bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsan/ khyad par chos sku ba las dus 'khor rgyud kyi skor dang / khyad par dbang mdor bstan/ dbang rab byed/ don dam bsnyen pa/ dka' 'grel pad+ma can/ rdo rje snying 'grel/ bde mchog bstod 'grel/ sbas pa mig 'byed/ snying po gsal ba/ dpe med 'tsho'i gsung rab rin chen 'dus pa/ de'i 'grel pa nyi ma dpal gyis mdzad pa/ shākya shrī'i sbyor drug snyan rgyud/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ rgyud pa'i lo rgyus/ rdo rje tshig gi mdud 'grol rtsa 'grel/ gces pa bsdus pa'i sgron ma/ gsal sgron bzhi/ gsung sgros rgyas pa 'od zer phreng ba/ sems thag gcad pa/ mtshams sbyor bzhi pa/ ro bcud dpe don/ sbyor drug 'bring po/ bsdus pa/ 'khrid kyi sngon 'gro rgyas bsdus/ 'bro lo tsā ba'i sbyor drug 'jam gsar gyi sbyor drug nā ro pa'i sgrom lde bskor la sogs pa mang du gsan cing sgrub pa mdzad pas stong gzugs 'jams nas 'gro ba dang / rnam kun mchog gi sku rags pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / phra ba sen mo'i steng na bzhugs pa kun mi tshad tsam du song na 'dzam bu'i gling du mi shong snyam pa dang / dbang po drug nang ting nge 'dzin gyi yul drug la 'khyams nas 'gro ba byung / de ltar thugs dam dang nyan bshad spel nas mdzad de/ 'dar du zur chos/ 'khyog tu gdan sa/ skyang 'dur du gdan sa mdzad nas phar tshad/ mngon pa/ dbu ma sogs gsung zhing 'gro don mdzad pa'i skabs su/ dus zhabs pa nas brgyud pa'i srog rtsol gyi man ngag khyad par can kha che shākya shrī nas sa skya paṇa chen la brgyud pa dol po ye shes mgon la gsan nas skyang 'dur du 'dag char mdzad de bsgoms pas mthong snang 'ur langs/ gegs kyi rnam pa mang du byung la gegs sel gyi gdams ngag mdzad pas phal cher phan te/ sgra snyan gyis chos zab mo'i don ston pa/

chos 'jig rten gyi bya ba sna tshogs ston pa/ phyi nang thams cad mngon sum ltar mthong ba/ gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes/ bde ba can du spyan 'dren pa yin zer ba'i bsu ba'i bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung / de'i tshe bud med cig gis lde mig gcig khyer byung nas sgo lcags la bkal song / sgo phye gcig pa'i brdar 'dug dgongs nas/ gegs sel gyi bye brag 'dra ba brtsams pas rlung lnga stobs su gyur pa'i nyams shar te/ rlung gi rlung stobs su gyur pas phyag ya re la mi drug bdun res bzung yang kun phyogs rer 'phang nus pa/ sa rlung stobs su gyur pas mi 'ga' res bsgul mi nus pa sogs byung / de dag bla ma thams cad mkhyen pas mngon shes kyis gzigs te/ gser sdings nas byon/ 'di nyid kyi'ang mngon shes kyis bla ma dang mjal bar dgongs nas slob ma rnams la/ bla ma dang mjal bar 'dug gis gsol ba thob gsung / sang snga dro bla ma byon/ sngar gyi gsung gleng mdzad pas da lan gshegs na sku bzhi la 'byor pa'i lugs yin/ 'on kyang khyed kyi sku tshe 'di nyid kyis sems can dpag tu med pa sgrol ba'i phrin las 'byung ba yin pas dpon slob gnyis kas 'bad la sku mi gshegs pa bgyi 'tshal gsung nas bka' sgros gegs sel mdzad pas/ bsu ba'i bkod pa rnams kyang da lan gdan mi 'drongs par 'dug zer nas gyes pa'i snang ba byung / de nas gegs sol te rim gyis sku khams dwangs so/ /gzhan yang bla ma ye rin las 'di'i khrid zhus/ chor skor ci rigs pa dang / bang so 'dag char ba las gsal sgron bzhi dang / khrid rim gong ma/ dol po ba las gyi jo'i ngo sprod pad+ma 'od zer/ tsa mi/ a bha ya/ rgwa lo/ zhang mtshal pa/ mar pa bya ze ba/ rwa pa/ pha rgyud gsang 'dus pa/ ma rgyud kye rdor gyi sbyor drug la sogs pa mang du gsan cing / 'dzims pa rin she las kyang mang du gsan no/ /de nas sgrub pa rtse gcig tu mdzad pa'i phyir/

skyang 'dur nas chos gzhi 'pho ba'i skabs su/ dpon dang dge bshes rnams la zhal brda'i yi ge bzhag nas dge slong thugs she dang / nye gnas ston pa zhabs tog tu khrid/ gsang thabs su byon pas mi ma yin gyi bsu ba dang bsnyen bkur gyi rnam pa mang du byung / phyis kyi sgrub gnas dang 'gro don ji ltar 'byung ba'i snang ba shar/ ston lha sar byon gsol ba 'debs kyin bzhugs pa'i tshe/ khro phu'i jo gdan 'dan mas 'gro don rgya cher 'byung bar mngon shes kyis lung bstan/ de nas khrid zab mo rnams mdzad kyin gtsang phyogs kyi ri khrod mang du bskor/ se mkhar chung du gtsug lag khang bsos/ 'brog mi'i sku 'bum la gser gsol/ rab gnas mdzad pas mnal lam du mi ma yin mang pos se mkhar chung bya ba'i ban rgan de 'dir byung zhes sgrogs pa gsan/ nags rgyal gyis jo nang du gdan 'dren du byung / lo gsum na 'byon par zhal gyis bzhes/ gyi jo'i rgyud snying gzigs te rgyud snying bsdu bar dgongs dbu sngas su bzhag mchod gtor phul gsol ba btab pas mnal lam du rigs ldan rnams kyis 'di bslab pa kun las btus bya ba yin gsung ba dang / la las theg pa kun btus bya bar gyis la bsdus bya ba byung / sbyor drug rdzogs par gdul bya kun la bstan par dgongs pa na/ bstan du mi 'dod pa'i ltas byung bas/ lha sa'i gtsug lag khang rnams dang / khyad par bcu gcig zhal gyi drung du gsol ba btab pas mnal lam du mkha' la nyi ma gsum shar ba sogs 'gro phan yong ba'i ltas byung nas g.yas ru'i ri khrod rnams su dbang mdzad/ srog rtsol chig brgyud du btab pas grol ba mang du byung / de nas nags phug tu byon pa na mkhan po gtsug tor mgon la sogs pa'i dge bshes rnams kyis jo nang du gdan drangs/ 'khrug po'i lha btsan gyis rta ba'i tshogs kyis bsu zhing bskor ba byas/ seng ge rdzong du bzhugs rgyud snying yang rdzogs te rigs ldan rnams kyis legs so'i gnang ba dang /

mkha' spyod bde ldan du byon pa'i tshe rigs ldan rnams byon nas rgyud snying la brjod bya dus kyi 'khor lo chug la ston gsung ba'i gnang ba thob/ gdul bya dpag tu med pa smin grol la bkod de/ byi ba lo'i khrid rnams rdzogs pa dang drung na yod pas da lo sku khams bzang par gda' zhus pas/ mar me 'chi khar gsal/ da lo tsam las chos 'chad pa mi yong gsung / tshogs su yang 'jig rten gyi bya ba la snying po med/ sgrub pa gtso bor gyis/ blo dman pas kyang 'chi khar mi 'gyod tsam gyi sgrub pa re gal che ba yin gsung / de nas dgun mtshams la bzhugs tsam na sman pa la ston pa dang / sku rim bgyi ba zhus pas/ sman rim gros mi phan/ da lo 'gro ba yin yang khag 'jog yong gsung nas sman pa la'ang bstan/ bu slob kun gyi sku rim rgya chen yang byas/ de'i tshe sa g.yo ba dang sgra dang / mtshan mo 'od kyi rnam 'gyur mang po byung ba phyi na yod pa'i gzhi ba dang / mgron po rnams kyis mthong zhing thos/ dgun smad bla ma byang sems pa la mgur cham byung yod pa la phan na myur bar shog gsung nas/ byon pa na spyir da lo 'gro/ de yang me tog khra chil ba'i dus la 'gro bar 'dug snyam pa na/ mdang zhag blo bur du rtsa btul ba gcig byung / de la nged 'gro dus khyed dang phrad dgos pa la ma sleb pa dang / 'gro snyam pa'i dus las snga bar byung bas/ nga dus kyi 'khor lo'i rnal 'byor pa yin/ khyed kyis btungs na ngas bsrings pas chog snyam ste/ rlung sbyor 'ga' byas pas rtsa rang sor chud/ zla phyed tsam 'chi ba bslus bdog gsung / dgun sku khams bzang phyag rtsa bde na gshegs pa'i rtags ci lags zhus pas/ sems la dbang thob pa 'gro ba la rtags ci dgos/ lus 'di'i gdul bya rnams kyi don ni grub zin/ da 'gro phan gang che byed gsung / gang du che zhus pas/ 'dir bsdad kyang gdul bya mang du mi 'gro/ byang sems kyi 'gro don la ris su chad pa med/

ngas dgun po bar do'i lus su bsgyur nas 'jig rten gyi khams mang po bskor/ bar do mang po bsgral/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing mang po bltas/ bde ba can/ dga' ldan/ sham+bha la rnams su phyin/ bar do la skye sgo dkon pa yin zer/ nga la ni skye sgo mang / bde ba can na rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i pad mo kha bye ba dpag tu med pa snang / gzhan yang 'jig rten gyi khams na rigs gzugs phun sum tshogs pa'i skye sgo mang po 'dug kyang / nga dga' ldan du 'gro bas de rnams su skye ba ma blangs gsung / dga' ldan du gshegs pa'i 'dun pa bsgyur gsung ba la ma bsgyur ba ci lags zhus pas/ nyan bshad kyi dus na dga' ldan du byams pa la dngos su sgro 'dogs bcad snyam nas 'dun pa drag po dang / skye ba'i rten 'brel sgrigs/ mkhan chen khro phu ba dang dpon slob gang sa nas rten 'brel 'grig pa gcig byung nas 'dun pa ma bsgyur/ bar do la da lta'i cho ga chos bshad phan par gsungs kyang / de bas bar do'i rigs mthun gyi lus kyis bsgral na stobs che bas/ shi ba dang bar dor rigs mthun gyis bar do'i don byed/ rgyal ba'i zhing mang po blta/ de nas dga' ldan du 'gro gsung / de'i sang slob dpon ston pa dang / lha rje sogs mi bcu tsam bsags nas 'di la brag ri nags phug la sogs pa'i mi sna tshang 'dug gzhan dang mi phrad kha chems khyed rnams la 'jog gsung nas/ byang sems pa la sngar bzung byas pa yin te 'dzin du ma 'dod/ da khyed las 'os mi 'dug pas ri khrod 'di zungs gsung / da dung yun ring du bzhugs par zhu zhus pas/ de skad byas pas don mi 'grub/ ngas 'gro bar thag bcad zin/ ngas bcol ba'i las khas long / nga'i tshig gi tha ma yin mod go cha ma byung gsung / byang sems pas bdag gis yun ring brten pas rnam thar ci rigs go ba dang / slob dpon dpashi dang / ston pa la sogs dbu che rnams dang gros btun nas/

bla ma'i rnam thar ci skyong byed par zhu/ zhus pas/ gtam de yin/ rten 'brel thams cad nga rang gis bsgrigs nas yod pas khyod la sems las chen po mi dgos legs par 'ong gsung nas/ rdor dril la sogs pa gsang sngags pa'i chas/ phyag dpe/ thugs dam gyi lha rnams rgyu mtshan dang bcas nas gnang / de'i skabs su byang sems pa'i mgur cham 'khrugs nas bsnyung ba la 'di nyid kyis rtsa gzigs/ nga na bas khyod bos pa yin te/ khyod 'chi ru cha gcig 'dir sleb byung / nga do zhag 'gro ba'i rtsis yin te/ ngas phyin na khyod kyang de'i rkyen gyis 'gro bar 'dug pas khyod kyi khams ma sos bar du ngas tshe bsrings la bsdad/ khyod rang sems las gang yang ma byed/ sman pa rnams kyis sman dpyad la 'byang pa thon/ slob dpon dpashis phyi'i tshogs kyi bsngo ba dang / rim 'gro ba'i mgo 'dren gyis/ khong nang du bsdad na nga shi 'dug snyam nas phyi'i tsho blo mi bde ba yin/ slob dpon seng ge/ sher 'bum/ btsun chung rnams kyis nga'i g.yog gyis/ slob dpon ston pas bug sgo'i nang 'dri ba rnams la brda sbyor/ bsod rin gyis phyi'i mgron po rnams kyi ngo len gyis/ rang re rnams blo lhod byas nas gnas lugs kyi ngang la 'jog pa yin/ sems las bya rgyu med/ blos byas 'khrul pa'i rjes su ma 'breng gsung / phyi'i dge bshes rags rim dang mjal bar zhus pas/ 'u cag la dbye bsal gyi lugs med/ thams cad la 'phrad pas shed zad/ stan la 'byar 'gro/ de tsa na bu slob la khag yong / khag med byas nas 'gro/ khyed rnams la khag byung gi dogs na yi ge bzhag gsung nas gsung chems mdzad/ phal cher ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs/ skabs su sngags zab tshul/ sa lam bgrod tshul/ 'chi khar 'od gsal la thim yang / gzhan don du 'od gsal las langs nas ci phan byed 'tshal gsung nas nye gnas rnams la gnang sbyin/ zhal brda na bza' gdan 'di la 'di byin gyi zhal brda/

spur bzhu tshul/ der mchod rten gcig gyis la tsha tsha rnams der chud/ khyod kyi rab gnas gyis/ tshogs su tsha bur gcig brdegs yod pas gshegs rdzongs dang rab ston yin gyis la me la thong / kun spangs kyi bya ba mthar phyin/ don gnyis 'grub/ bde ba nas bde bar 'gro ba la bu slob kun dga' spro byed dgos pa yin gsung ba dang / byang sems pa la shog gsung nas/ rdo rje slob dpon du dbang bskur ba'i tshigs bcad gsungs nas rdo rje dril bu gnang / khyod kyi khams ni sor chud 'dug da nga 'gro gsung / da dung yun ring du bzhugs par zhu zhus pas/ gtad pa ci bdog khar sang sngon la zla phyed bsrings nas bsdad/ 'dang sang khyod na ba des zhag nyi shu lhag gcig bsdad/ sems can la mi phan pa'i btang snyoms su bsdad nas ci byed/ phung po 'di nga song ma thag bzhus kyang chog nga ro'i nang du 'od gsal bsgom gyin sdod bya ba'i lugs min/ zhen pa byed na zhag bdun gsol ba thob/ bzhu dus bu slob kun la skad gyis la phyi nas gsol ba 'debs su chug gsung nas dpyid 'bring gi nyi shu lnga'i tho rangs zhi bar gshegs so/ /de nas gdung la zhag bdun gsol ba btab ste bzhu bas gdung thal thams cad ring bsrel gyi phung por gyur to/ /de la kun mkhyen 'phags pas gsan te/ nyangs stod thu gu dang nye ba'i la spe ba rje rigs sngags 'chang sha stag byung ba'i rgyud las/ yab rje bo rdo rje/ yum rje mo rgyal mtshan 'bum la sras brgyad byung ba'i chung shos yin/ bla ma chos sku 'od zer las rab tu byung ste/ dgung lo nyer gsum pa la 'bro lugs kyi sbyor drug tshang bar zhus/ skabs zhig tu bya btang du sku mtshams la bzhugs pa'i tshe/ kun spangs pas 'dir rgyud 'grel zhig 'bri ba dang / dus 'khor gyi thang ga zhig 'bri ba la rtsabs gcig shog gsung nas byon pa dang / rgyud snying gsung ba'i dbu tshugs 'dug pas sngon la 'di nyon cig gsung /

thugs la btags pa yin snyam ste mnyan pa dang / de'i 'phro cung ma tshar ba la khyod yi ge 'bri ba rkyang la bos pa min/ da res khrid 'di la zhugs shig gsung nas 'khrid la zhugs/ de ka'i 'phro la rgyun 'thud nas lo gsum la 'khrid yongs su rdzogs par mdzad/ bla ma'i gsung gis khyed rang 'dod cing mi bde ba byung na zhu ba su byung gi zla la shog gsung nas/ snga phyir 'khrid tshar ba lan bdun zhus/ phyag len thams cad legs par sbyangs/ gsung sgros rnams zin bris su mdzad/ 'khrul 'khor dgos pa rnams dpe chung du bris te legs par gtan la phab nas/ bla ma nyid la mnga' ba'i sbyor drug gi skor thams cad ma lus par gsan no/ /de la mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pas gsan te/ 'di ni sngags mtshan nyid mang du mkhyen pa'i bla ma brag ston rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang / yum bsod nams 'bum zhes pa'i sras su 'khrungs/ dgung lo bco brgyad pa la mkhan po rin chen seng ge dang / slob dpon tshad ma las rab tu byung ste mtshan rin chen grub tu btags pa nas bzung ste/ mtshan nyid kyi slob gnyer rnams phal cher tshar nas/ rong pa bla ma rdo rje rgyal mtshan la dus 'khor gsan pa'i dus su gsang 'dus shes pa zhig byung na slob gsungs pas/ nged kyi mched grogs slob dpon 'phags pa gsang 'dus la mkhas pa'i tshad du phyin/ der ma zad yo ga la'ang shin tu mkhas/ lung rgya'ang chen po byas pa cig yod gsung / gang na bdog zhus pas mag phyogs na yod gsung ste rtsad bcad pas/ 'phags pa'i ming 'dra ba zhig la 'khrul te/ thu gu'i tshar mi gcig na re/ de la yon tan chen po yod de/ sdom pa mi gtsang zer ba thos pas ma brtags par skyug log nas byon/ phyis kyi mkhar na bzhugs pa thos nas dge bshes bsod rin gdan 'dren du btang ste chos zhu bar brtsams pa na/ rmi lam du bud med gcig gis bum pa chus cung ma gang ba gcig dang / rnal 'byor pa gcig gis rdo rje dril bu gcig khyer byung nas 'di pa sngar khyed rang gi yin/

na ning nas brag ram na yar la 'phyan/ da khyed rang la gtod pa yin zer nas gtod du byung ba rmis/ thugs dgyes tshor dang bcas pas bla ma ba spyan drangs te gtso bor rim lnga'i khrid zhus pas sangs rgyas byang sems mang po ting nge 'dzin gyi rtsed mo sna tshogs mdzad pa/ bskyed rim gyi dus su lha so gnyis kyi zhal yud tsam gzigs/ rdor bzlas dus su rtags lnga dang rlung lnga so sor gsal ba gzigs pa la sogs pa dag snang du ma shar/ mnal lam sbyong pa'i tshe mngon dgar byon rin po che'i gzhal med khang na sangs rgyas stong gral bsgrigs su bzhugs pa gzigs zhing khams dag pa blta na nyi zla la zhon pa'am/ 'od zer la 'ju ba'am/ mkha' lding la zhon pa sogs byas nas gang 'gro 'dod pa'i yul du sleb pa snyam byas na mthong gin 'dug gsung / de'i rjes la gsang 'dus kyi skor dang / dus 'khor rwa 'bro'i skor/ sbyor drug mi 'dra ba bla ma nyid la ji ltar mnga' ba thams cad gsan/ phyis 'khrid yig ngo sprod dang bcas pa mdzad/ gdul bya dpag tu med pa smin grol gyi lam la bkod de/ de nyid la bdag gis chos skor thams cad tshang bar nod pa lags so/ /yang sha ba ri nas brgyud pa ltar na/ rdo rje 'chang ngam/ spyan ras gzigs la rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug sha ba ri pas gsan te/ 'di nyid grong khyer te te'i gar mkhan lo ki dang / gu na gnyis kyi bu tsha rigs ngan glu gar gyis 'tsho ba'i ming sring gsum bod pas/ slob dpon klu sgrub bha ga la'i ri bo'i dgon pa na bzhugs pa la slong du phyin pas/ rigs ngan la rnam rtog ma mdzad par nang du bos kha zas mang po byin pa dang / dad pa rnyed cing / byang sems blo gros rin chen gyi sku'i ras bris mthong nas 'di ci lags zhus pas/ byang sems lha'i bu tha mal pas mi mthong ba zhig yin gsung / bdag cag la bstan par zhu zhus pas/ spyi gtsug na yod kyis ltos gsung / de mthong ba'i spyan zhig zhu 'tshal zhus pas/

'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor du bcug dbang bskur/ rgyud bshad/ gdams pa dang rjes su gdams pa gnang nas nyams su long zhig par bka' stsal/ de dag gis kyang nan tan gyis nyams su blangs pas rgyud dag ste/ byang sems kyi zhal mthong gar gyi mchod pa phul/ bram ze chen po'i dho ha glur blangs te mchod pa phul bas/ khyod kyis de'i don shes sam gsung / mi shes pas zhu 'tshal zhus pas/ rgyud byin gyis brlabs dho ha'i don snying po don gyi dgongs pa bstan pas de nyid du de kho na nyid kyi rtogs pa thob bo/ /der byang chub sems dpas rigs kyi bu khyod lho phyogs ldong ngar gyi ston pa sha ba ri dbang phyug bya ba yin pas/ 'dir ma sdod par rngon pa'i chas su zhugs la lho phyogs dpal gyi ri/ sems ngal bso ba'i ri/ yid 'pham par byed pa'i ri la song la dbang po yang rab rnams kyi don gyis shig ces lung bstan pa bzhin de rnams kyis kyang de bzhin du byas pas/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub brnyes te/ ding sang gi bar du yang bzhugs zhes grag go /'dir sa ra ha dang gcig ces 'dod pa mi rigs te/ grub thob brgya bcu rtsa bzhi'i glu bsdus pa las/ sa ra has/ kye ho grogs dag lhan cig skyes pa de/ /gzhan nas mi rnyed bla ma'i zhal nas rnyed/ /don dam zhal gyi ngo bo de rtogs na/ /yid la 'chi ba med cing lus la 'chad pa med/ /ces dang / 'dis/ ma rig mun pa'i nags tshal du/ /gzung 'dzin gnyis kyi ri dwags rgyu/ /thabs shes gnyis kyi bzhu brdungs nas/ /snying po don gyi mda' gcig 'phangs/ /'chi ni rnam par rtog pa 'chi/ /sha ni gnyis su med par zos/ /ro ni bde ba chen por myong / /'bras bu phyag rgya chen po 'thob/ /ces glu so sor bshad cing / rdo rje gdan pas kyang / bram ze'i rigs la gar mkhan lus/ /dpal gyi ri la dngos grub brnyes/ /sa ra ha zhes bya ba yi/ /bla ma de la phyag 'tshal lo/

/zhes dang / gar mkhan dpal gyi ri la bzhugs/ /lcam sring gnyis kyis dngos grub brnyes/ /sha ba ri pa zhes bya ba'i/ /bla ma de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bstod pa so sor byas pas so/ /de la bla ma shrī bi bhū ti tsan+d+ra dpal rnam par 'byor ba'i zla ba zhes pas gsan te/ 'di nyid rgya gar shar phyogs ba ren tra pa dgos dza ga dha pa yin/ mang pos bkur pa'i sde las rab tu byung ba/ theg pa che chung gi chos ma lus pa la sbyangs shing / rig pa'i gnas lnga mkhyen pa/ thog mar 'jam dbyangs dang bde mchog la sogs pa thugs dam gyi lha rnams dang / ri khrod dbang phyug la sogs pa rnal 'byor dbang phyug du ma'i zhal dngos su gzigs te gdam ngag du thos pa yon tan gyi tshogs brjod kyis mi lang ba mnga' ba de nyid thang sbe ha ra na bzhugs pa'i tshe/ rgya gar gyi rnal 'byor pa rna ba la ri dwags kriṣ+ṇa sa ra'i rwa bcug pa/ de'i lpags pas smad dkris pa/ ras kyi 'ga' phyar thabs su bsnams pa lang 'tsho la bab pa zhig byon nas 'dir zhag 'ga' sdod pa yin gsung / der sgra slob pa gsum yod pa'i brang khang gcig tu bzhugs su bcug pas/ sgra slob pa de rnams na re/ rnal 'byor pa 'di ngo mtshar can gcig gda'o zer nas bla mas spyan drangs te chos kyi gsung gleng byas pas gang dris pa thams cad thogs pa med par byung / sha ba ri yin nam dgongs te yin nam zhus pas yin gsung / de nas tshogs 'khor bskor/ maṇ+ḍal phul te mdo rgyud thams cad kyi bcud bsdus pa'i snying po bskyed rdzogs kyi chos zhig zhu byas nas gsol ba btab pas/ sbyor ba drug gi man ngag 'di gnang nas/ nga 'gro gsung / gar gshegs zhus pas nub phyogs kha cher 'gro/ las can gyi gdul bya yod/ de nas dpal gyi ri la 'gro gsung nas gshegs te/ lang thang sbe ha rar zhag nyi shu rtsa gnyis bzhugs skad do/ /'di la dpyal a mo gha shrī bha dras zhu ba po mdzad nas lho ba tshul gzhon dang /

mar ston g.yang 'bar la sogs pa bdun la gnang ste/ de la dpyal a mo gha ni dpyal dkar nag khra gsum gyi dkar po'i brgyud du sku 'khrungs pa ste/ yab dge bshes pa stag dang / yum bkra shis dge gnyis las bskrun pa/ lhums su zhugs pa na yum la lus sems yang ba dang bde ba sogs dang / bltams pa'i tshe g.ya' bzang mo la kha ba babs pa sogs ltas khyad par can dang bcas te 'khrungs/ 'khrungs ma thag chos dang mjal/ byis pa' ིdus nas kun dga' zhing yid du 'ong bas kun dga'i snying por btags/ dgung lo bdun pa la 'bri klog mkhyen/ dgu pa la rdo rje gdan pa la kyai rdo rje'i dbang zhus pa'i tshe rdo rje 'chang dngos su gzigs/ de dang bla ma dpyal chos bzang gnyis la bde dgyes gshin rje gshed la sogs pa'i chos mang du gsan/ dgung lo bcu bdun pa la rab tu byung / paṇa chen shākya shrī dang / chu mig lung pa/ dum bu ko brag pa sogs las rgyud gzhung man ngag mang du gsan/ khyad par bi bhu ti tsan+d+ra rgya rtags nas spyan drangs/ skad gnyis yi ge dang bcas pa legs par bslabs/ chos mang du gsan/ khyad par dus kyi 'khor lo'i sbyor ba yan lag drug ma lus par gsan/ mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan tshad med pa mnga'/ bla ma'i thugs dgongs rdzogs pa'i phyir sku che ba gser sku khri yol dang bcas pa dang / gsung rab mang po bzhengs pa sogs dge ba'i bya ba rgya chen po yang mdzad/ gdul bya dpag tu med pa smin grol la bkod nas zhi bar gshegs pa na rje btsun seng ge sgras lung bstan pa ltar 'jig rten gyi khams pad+mo can du gshegs pas pad+mo can zhes par grags so/ /de la yang mar ston g.yang 'bar gyis gsan te/ 'di nyid gtsang gi sag dang gi se sper bzhugs pa ste/ bsgoms pa'i dus su rlung dbu mar chud pa'i rtags mang po byung / sangs rgyas kyi zhing mang po gzigs/ bla ma yang shin tu mnyes/ phyis gsal snang la mngon shes dang 'dra bar yul dang 'das ma 'ongs kyi bya ba thams cad gzigs skad do/

/de la bla ma rnal 'byor seng 'bum gyis gsan te/ 'di gnas nges pa med par ri khrod gang dben du bzhugs shing / spyir rgyud sde dang man ngag du ma gsan/ khyad par mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ste/ stong gzugs kyi ka bum la sogs gang rung dang bsres pas stong gzugs dang lus gcig tu gyur te sna tshogs su sprul nus pa/ stong gzugs kyi thig le'i nang du bltas pas gang 'dod pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing dang / sangs rgyas de'i zhal mthong ba la sogs pa mnga' ste/ bde ba can gzigs pa la sogs kyi lo rgyus kyang yod gsung ngo / /de la kun spangs chos rjes gsan/ de la bla ma rin chen dpal bzang pos gsan te/ 'di'i 'khrungs yul gsal lung spe rnga ba/ gdung rus byar/ dgung rta byi ba yin zhing gzhon nu la bla ma 'phags pa'i drung du thugs bskyed gsan/ spyi bo lhas pa'i mkhan po shes rab rgyal mtshan mkhas grub bzang po las rab tu byung ste mtshan rin chen dpal bzang por btags/ spyi lhas byang chub 'od kyis mdzad pa'i phar phyin khur chung grags pa la slob gnyer mdzad nas gsungs/ bka' gdams kyi chos mang du gsan te/ mkhan po de nyid dang las slob slob dpon bsod nams 'bum/ gsang ston slob dpon thub pas mdzad nas bsnyen par rdzogs/ brag ram du dbu ma pa sher 'bum gyi drung du phar tshad/ dbu ma rigs gter la sogs pa'i chos mang du gsan nas mthar phyin par mdzad/ slar spyi bo lhas su byon nas phar tshad kyi bshad nyan mdzad/ de'i bar bar la sa skyar byon/ bla ma 'phags rgyal las bde dgyes kyi skor dang / gro smon can pa'i bla ma dkon mchog shes rab las sman bla/ phag mo/ phyag chen la sogs pa'i skor dang / bde mchog gi zhal mngon sum du gzigs pa'i 'jam dbyangs nags pa las bde mchog gi skor rnams gsan/ khyad par jo mo nang du byon/ chos rje kun spangs la sbyor drug zhus te/

thugs dam mdzad/ sang dngos gzhi la 'jug pa'i nub mo gnas po dang gsung gleng mdzad de/ phar phyin dang sbyor drug gnyis sa mtshams dang sgom tshul 'dra bar 'dug gsungs pas/ sang chos la byon dus chos rje pas legs par gzigs te/ khyed gnyis phar phyin dang sbyor drug sa mtshams sbyor ba bas bsgoms na rang khe che ba yin te gsung du byung gsungs/ bsgoms pas mtshan ma'i rim pa rnams legs par thugs rgyud la 'khrungs shing 'byon khar byin rlabs zhus pa'i tshe/ khyed kyi sgom rtse gcig tu byas na yon tan skye bar 'dug ste e byed mi shes gsung ba/ dus phyis bdag cag gi rtsar bzhugs dgos pa la lta ba yin nam gsung / de ltar bka' mdo rgyud/ lung man ngag mang po'i pha rol du son nas sgro smon can gyi gdan sar bzhugs/ sgrub pa snying por mdzad pa'i tshe/ bla ma dam pa don yod rgyal mtshan pas gtso mdzad bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa dang / gzhan yang dbus gtsang gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen mi chen mang po'i gtsug rgyan du gyur kyang khengs pa mi mnga' zhing / byang chub kyi sems 'byongs pa/ yi dam gyi bskyed rim brtan pa/ lhag pa'i tshul khrims la nyes pa phra zhing phra ba nas kyang ma gos par bsrung ba/ 'phral gyi bzlas pa sogs thugs dam gyi rim pa la nam yang mi g.yel ba/ phyag rdzas ci byung yang dkon mchog mchod pa dang / dge 'dun gyi zhabs tog 'ba' zhig tu gtong ba/ drung na 'dug pa'i tshe'ang khro ba dang / 'jig rten gyi gtam dang / bkod pa la sogs gsung ba dang mdzad pa gang yang mi mnga' bar/ drung na 'dug pa thams cad dam pa'i chos 'ba' zhig la sbyor ba la sogs 'phral gyi kun spyod gang la bltas kyang ngo mtshar ba sha stag las/ yid la mi 'tsham pa gang yang med pas dgung lo don gnyis kyi bar du thos bsam sgom gsum rgyun ma chad par mdzad de/ 'os su gyur pa'i gdul bya rnams dus las mi yol bar smin grol la bkod nas/

phag lo zla ba bzhi pa'i nyi shu gnyis kyi srod la thugs dam rtse gcig pa'i ngang nas zhi bar gshegs pa'i tshul bstan te/ gsol ba 'debs pa dang / spur zhugs la bzhen pa'i dus su'ang ngo mtshar ba'i ltas phun sum tshogs pas 'gro ba rnams kyi rgyud tshim par mdzad do/ /bla ma de nyid las bdag cag gis kyai rdo rje'i dbang rgyud la sogs pas thogs drangs pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs mang po dang / khyad par thog ma nyid du sbyor ba yan lag drug gi 'khrid lan gnyis su zhus nas yid ches pa'i mtshan ma thob par 'gyur pa lags so/ /yang chos rje kun spangs pa la bla ma dam pa brag kha bas gsan te/ g.yas ru byang gi rgyal sde thang khar 'khrungs pa/ gdung rus rlan/ yab brgya bon 'od ldan/ yum lha bzo pir thogs kyi dpon po mang mgar ba rin chen dpal gyi a lce yin zhing / yos lo la 'khrungs/ gzhon nu'i dus su rin po che khro phu ba las rab tu byung ste mtshan grags pa seng ger btags/ sa skya zhe dgon pa'i bla ma gong ma phya ru ba seng ge dpal las rnam 'grel gsan/ nar longs pa na mkhan po snga ma dang / las slob dbu ma pa sher 'bum/ bu ston seng 'od kyis gsang ston mdzad de bsnyen par rdzogs/ bstan pa'i snying po sgrub pa nyams len yin par dgongs nas/ chos rje kun spangs pa'i drung du sbyor drug gi dbang nod/ sbyor drug zhus nas sgrub pa rtse gcig tu mdzad/ bla ma dam pa de nyid kyi thugs kyi sras byang sems rgyal ye las kyang sbyor drug zhus/ dus 'khor gyi rgyud gsan par dgongs nas kun spangs pa la zhus pas/ rong du song gsung ba bzhin byon te/ bla ma rgwa lo'i sras chung ba bla ma a ka ra las dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud 'grel yan lag dang bcas pa ma lus par gsan pas don phyin ci ma log par thugs su chud nas g.ya' lung gi dur khrod du sgrub pa gtsor mdzad/ zhor la skal ldan rnams la rgyud 'grel dang 'khrid gsungs te smin grol la bkod/

de nas lo spe ba dkon bzangs kyis yon bdag mdzad de stag gi lo rgyal khams su kha mo che byung ba'i tshe brag khar phyags phab/ brag rtse na spe'u gcig yod pa'i sgo brtsigs nas dkyus gcig la dus 'khor gyi bsnyen pa bye ba dang / sbyin sreg 'bum phrag gcig mdzad/ de'i tshe me lce thams cad rin po che'i rnam par 'bar ba la sogs pa byin rlabs kyi mtshan ma mang du byung / de nas bzung ste thugs dam nyid gtso bor mdzad de/ zhag re la lus sbyong lan drug re mdzad/ de ma gtogs pa thams cad bskyed rdzogs kyi ngang du bzhugs/ chos gsung ba yang de nyid kyi ngang nas mdzad/ dbu ma/ byams chos/ spyod phyogs/ rgyud/ man ngag gi mkhyen rab dpag tu med pa mnga' yang / sbyor drug dmar khrid/ gcod/ gzer lnga rnams la khrid chen bzhir ming btags nas gtso bor skyong / dbyar mtshams dus phal cher rgyun gcod la bzhugs/ phyag tu dngos po byung tshad bla ma rnams dang / khyad par jo mo nang / rong / khro phu rnams su rim par bla ma'i thugs dgongs rdzogs pa'i thabs su phul/ phyogs ris kyi chos zhu bya bral ba rnams dang / gang na su bzang / 'chad nyan nus zer ba rnams la 'phral gyi mthun rkyen du gnang ba sogs chos phyogs 'ba' zhig tu btang / bzhi thog gi bla ma mkhas btsun chen pos dbu mdzad mi che dgu/ bzang dgu rnams kyi gtsug rgyan du gyur nas 'gro don phyogs med du mdzad de sku tshe'i mthar/ sa skya'i thog drangs rgyal khams spyi'i chags 'jig bde dog rang nyid gshegs dus la sogs ma 'ongs pa'i tshul phyis mngon du gyur pa bzhin thog ma nyid du legs par gsung ba sogs mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' zhing / rang nyid bzhed pa bzhin grub pas thugs rangs te dgyes pa chen po dang / ma 'ongs pa na phrin las phun tshogs mthar phyin pa'i rgyur gshegs pa'i tshe dkon mchog la mchod pa rgya chen po phul/

smon lam dri ma med pa dpag tu med pa mdzad nas dgung lo gya dgu bzhes pa lug lo zla ba lnga pa'i tshes lnga'i gro bar tsam la/ ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas nas 'od gsal chen po'i ngang du zhing 'di'i mdzad pa bsdus te/ spur zhugs la bzhen pa na'ang gzha' 'od la sogs pa'i ltas khyad par can du ma dang bcas nas sku gdung ring bsrel gyi snying po can du gyur to/ /bla ma dam pa 'di nyid la bdag gis dus 'khor thugs dkyil rgyas pa dang / lha dgu ma'i dbang / gcod/ dmar khrid sdo ha/ dbyug pa la sogs pa'i man ngag mang po zhus shing / 'di'i thugs kyi sras bang mo zhu ba bla ma gzhon nu dpal ba las brag kha bas mdzad pa'i sbyor drug ngo sprod la sogs pa zab lam gyi skor mang du zhus so/ /yang chos rje kun spangs pa la bla ma dam pa sron pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis gsan te/ 'di ni sa chen rgyal po'i zu gur che yin pa/ bla ma dam pa 'phags pas dbang yon la 'di phul gsung nas bzhes/ phyags phyi mdzad nas chos dang gdams ngag mang du zhus/ bla ma zhi bar gshegs pa dang / chos rje kun spangs pa la zab lam zhus te bsgom pas ting nge 'dzin phul du byung ba 'khrungs/ khyad par ra za rin chen gling du stong gzugs kyi shā ba ri pa las chos gsan/ spyan ras gzigs kyi skus tshig dang lag len du bcas te gdams ngag bstan pas bgegs zhi ba la sogs pa'i yon tan dpag tu med pa mnga'/ rlung la dbang thob pa la sogs pa dang / lha sku sogs las gsan pa'i gdam ngag mang po mnga'o/ /de nyid la rtse gcig tu thugs dam la gzhol zhing / rlung gi yon tan tshad med pa mnga' ba'i bla ma chos dpal bzang pos gsan/ de la bdag cag gis bla ma yab sras las brgyud pa'i gdam ngag rlung gi yon tan dpag tu med pa yod pa rnams zhus shing / yang bla ma chos dpal ba la bdag cag gi mkhan po byang chub kyi sems chen po'i mthus skye bo phal mo che'i mgon skyabs dang 'dren pa dam par gyur pa/

bslab pa rin po che'i mdzod mnga' zhing phyi nang gi yon tan tshad med pas rab tu mdzes pa'i bla ma dam pa mkhan chen bsod nams grags pas gsan te/ 'di nyid la'ang bdag gis sron pa las brgyud pa'i gdam ngag rnams kyang nod pa lags so/ /grub pa thob pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po shrī a nu pa ma rak+ṣi ta dpe med 'tsho'i bsrung ba zhes pa des mdzad pa'i sbyor ba drug gi man ngag ltar na/ phyi nang gi rig pa'i gnas thams cad la sbyangs pa'i thugs can slob dpon dpe med 'tsho des rtog pa dang dmigs pa med pa'i de kho na nyid sgom zhing / khar sa pa ṇi'i drung du lo bcu gnyis bzhugs/ rtsa'i 'dab ma la sogs pa'i bcud len gyis 'tsho bar mdzad pa las rtogs pa'i khyad par ma thob pas bsgoms pa la thugs chad de/ mnal du song ba la rdo rje rnal 'byor mas/ bi kra ma pu rar song zhig der khyod la rtogs pa'i khyad par 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes lung bstan to/ /mnal sad pa dang bka' de spyi bor bzhag nas rang gi slob ma paṇ+ḍi ta chen po legs pa'i bu dpal 'dzin dang lhan cig bi kra mar gshegs te/ der tshigs mtshams kyi nyin zhag zhig la thugs dam la bzhugs pa'i tshe/ mtshan phyed kyi dus su a wa dhū tī'i cha byad can du rdo rje 'chang nyid byon te/ kye bu 'di ni de kho na nyid do zhes mngon sum du gdams pa bstan to/ /de thos pa tsam gyis ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs shing / bcom ldan 'das kyang de nyid du mi snang bar gyur to/ /mtshan mo de 'das pa dang bdag nyid chen po des de'i zhabs tog la dka' ba dpag med mdzad cing / skal ba dang ldan pa'i dpal 'dzin la rang gi rtogs pa bstan to/ /mchog tu thugs rje can des kyang thams cad du snod dang ldan par dgongs nas/ paṇ+ḍi ta chen po 'od byed lha la bka' drin du mdzad/ des kyang paṇ+ḍi ta chen po rgyal po'i bla ma snying ma'i dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa chos kyi 'byung gnas zhi ba la bshad/

kha na ma tho ba med pa'i thugs rje la sogs pa yon tan brjod du med pa'i rin po che'i 'byung gnas des kyang bla ma'i zhabs bsten pa la mkhas pa grub pa thob pa'i slob dpon nyi ma dpal ye shes la gnang / des grub thob chen po bde mchog gi zhal mngon sum du gzigs shing / rtse gcig tu ting nge 'dzin la gzhol ba rin chen 'tsho la gnang / des kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta shākya shrī'i paṇa chung bi bhū ti tsan+d+ra la gnang / yang na chos 'byung zhi bas paṇ+ḍi ta chen po grags pa'i lha/ des paṇ+ḍi ta chen po chos bzang / des bi bhū ti tsan+d+ra la gnang / des bod du byon pa'i dus su mang po la gnang yang / mchog tu gyur pa bla ma ko brag pa dang / g.yung phug pa/ nyag po chos ldan gsum la gnang / de gsum ka la rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po go lung pa gzhon nu dpal gyis zhus/ de la rig pa'i gnas thams cad la sbyangs shing rgyud sde mtha' dag gi dgongs pa phyin ci ma log par rtogs pas 'chi 'pho skye bo mngon par shes pa'i mngon shes sogs mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan bla na med pas phyug cing / ngur smrig 'dzin pa rnams kyi nang nas btsun pa'i mchog tu gyur pa lo tsā ba chen po nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyis gsan/ de la 'gran zla thams cad dang bral ba'i mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pas gsan te/ khro phur bzhugs pa'i tshe ye shes seng ge zer ba'i grwa pa gcig gis zhag 'ga' chos bcag nas nyin gcig byung ba na 'di gcig pu'i don yang mi nus na gzhan lta ci smos/ da dung rang gi 'dod chos 'dra zhu ba rang drag par 'dug dgongs nas mkhan chen thar pa can byon/ sgra'i skor rnams gsan/ khyad par sbyor drug zhus pas dbang gong ma mdzad pa'i tshe ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo du ma thugs la 'khrungs/ bsgoms pas nyams snang tshad med pa shar/ bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos kyi mos pa skyes so/ /rwa lugs kyi brgyud pa ltar na/ 'jam dpal gyi sprul pa las grub thob tsi lu ā tsār+ya/

ba ren+t+ra'i paṇ+ḍi ta ā tsār+ya/ tso ra ya sha'i dus 'khor zhabs che ba/ mañju ha de shar 'khrungs pa'i dus zhabs pa chung pa/ mda' 'jim grags pa'am/ rin chen 'byung gnas sbas pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta 'jam dpal grags pa/ nai pā mi'i rol pa'i grong khyer gyi mkhas pa kun bzang dpal/ de la bla ma go lung pa gzhon nu dpal/ de la mkhan chen thar pa bas gsan/ yang dus zhabs pa chung ba la 'jam dpal grags pa/ des sa man+ta shrī/ des rwa chos rab/ des rwa ye shes seng ge rwa 'bum seng / rje btsun rgwa lo/ yang de nyid kyis dpyal a mo gha la yang gsan/ yang dus zhabs pa chung ba la a bha ya dang / tsa mi/ de gnyis las rgwa lo/ de las tsa mi rgwa lo nas rgyud pa'i sbyor drug dang / sa lugs kyi sbyor drug yang dus zhabs pa chung ba/ dpe med 'tsho/ a bha ya/ rnam bzod lha/ ngang byed lha dbang / paṇa chen shākya shrī/ sa skya paṇa chen/ rgyus pa gzhon seng / dol po ye shes mgon/ kun spangs pa las srog rtsol rdo rje'i snyan rgyud dang / nā ro pa/ 'jigs med grags pa/ kha che paṇa chen/ dpyal chos bzang / a mo gha nas nā ro pa dang / shāka shrī'i sbyor drug shākya shrī dang / chag las a bha ya'i sbyor drug dus zhabs che ba/ bar pa dge bsnyen bo dhi/ chung ba shrī bha dra bo dhi/ gyi jo phrom lo tsā ba las gyi jo'i lugs kyi sbyor drug rnams brgyud do// //gnyis pa de las brgyud pa'i gdams pa dngos la mtshan gyi don dang / man ngag dngos ngo sprad pa gnyis kyi/ dang po la/ mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas ni skad cig dang / rnam pa lnga dang / rnam pa nyi shu dang / sgyu 'phrul dra bas mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa'i mtshan nyid/ 'gyur med bde bas dang por sangs rgyas pa ste/ skad cig gcig ni rgyu rgyud la mngal 'dzin pa'i tshe ma'i mngal du kun gzhi zhugs pa/ rnam pa lnga rnam shes lnga rig cing 'bur po lnga 'thon pa/ rnam pa nyi shu sor mo nyi shu dod pa/

sgyu 'phrul dra ba mngal nas 'thon te dngos po mtha' yas rig pa/ lam gyi bsnyed rim la dkrong gang skad cig gis yin pa de ni sems can rnams rdzus skyes las bskyed pa'o/ /bskyed/ mngon byang lnga/ las rgyal mchog phra thig rdzogs rim la ting nge 'dzin/ sor bsam/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni rtog pa dang bral ba ste/ nam mkha' las byung rang byung ba/ /shes rab ye shes me bo che/ /'od chen rnam par snang bar byed/ /ye shes snang ba lam me ba/ /zhes pa la sogs pa rnam pa lngas mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pas rtogs par bya'o/ /srog 'dzin/ rjes sgyu 'phrul dra bas mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa ni sku rdo rje ste de nyid rnam pa bcu drug rig pa mtha' yas pa'i sgyu 'phrul dra ba dag gis spros pa'i sku'o/ zhes dang / nā ro pas/ sna tshogs pa'i sgyu ma sprul pa'i mtshan nyid de sku'i dga' ba la sogs pa'i thig le bcu drug 'gog pa las rnam par shes par bya'o/ /zhes so/ /dran/ 'bras bu la ngo bo nyid/ chos/ longs/ sprul sku'o/ /dang por sangs rgyas pa thog mtha' med pa'i dus su sangs rgyas pa ste de brjod pa'i phyir/ de skad ces bya ste/ brjod bya mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas brjod par byed pa'i phyir te/ brjod bya 'di brjod par byed pa'i ngo bo nyid kyis gnas pa'i phyir mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas so/ /zhes so/ /stong phrag bcu gnyis pa ni/ rkang pa gcig la yi ge brgyad dang / sh+lau ka gcig la yi ge so gnyis pa rjes su bsngags pa'i sdeb sbyor can te/ stong phrag bcu gnyis pa zhes pa ni/ stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi lhag pa'i 'bum phrag gsum gyi yi ge'i tshogs te/ yi ge sum cu rtsa gnyis pa rjes su bsngags pa stong phrag bcu gnyis yod pa ni stong phrag bcu gnyis pa'o/ /zhes so/ /rigs med pa ni shes rab thabs kyi phyogs lhung med par gnyis med kyi rnal 'byor brjod pa'i phyir te/

rigs med pa zhes pa ni brjod bya rigs med pa brjod par byed pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes so/ /de yang don dam pa las yin te/ des na don dam pa'i bden pas/ thabs dang shes rab kyi bdag nyid can rnal 'byor gyi rgyud rigs med pa dus kyi 'khor lo'o/ /zhes so/ /kun rdzob tu ni tha dad do/ /dus kyi 'khor lo zhes pa phyir nyi zla'i bgrod pa gnyis/ khyim gyi 'khor lo dang / nang du nyin mtshan gcig gi dbus nyi khri chig stong drug brgya'i 'khor lo ste/ gzhan du bskyed pa la rten dang brten pa'i lha tshogs dang / dus sbyor bcu gnyis kyi bdag nyid gtso bo'i sku/ rdzogs pa la 'gyur med ye shes kyi phung khams skye mched sgrib pa med par gyur pa'o/ /yang na kā la tsakra zhes pa'i ka ra ṇa rgyu/ shān+ti zhi ba/ la yo tra thim pa/ tsā la tsit+ta g.yo ba'i sems/ kra ma rim pa/ ban dha nad bcings pa ste/ sad/ rmi/ gnyid stug bzhi pa'i gnas skabs kyi rgyu lus ngag yid ye shes kyi thig le 'gags pa sprul/ longs/ chos/ lhan skyes kyi sku ste de brjod pa'i phyir/ dus kyi 'khor lo ni brjod bya dus kyi 'khor lor brjod par byed pa'i phyir dus kyi 'khor lo'i rjod byed do/ /zhes so/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ye shes kyi sku mngon du gyur pa'i mtshan yang dag par brjod pas 'khyud pa ni/ 'gyur med bde ba'i bdag nyid ye shes kyi sku mngon du gsal bar ston pa'i mtshan brjod ltar/ thog ma med pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis bstan/ ston par 'gyur/ ston pa'i dang po'i sangs rgyas brjod pa ste/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ye shes kyi sku mngon du gyur pa'i mtshan yang dag par brjod pas 'khyud pa zhes pa ni dang po'i sangs rgyas mngon par brjod pa nyid kyi phyir ro/ /zhes so/ rgyud kyi rgyal po thams cad kyi rdo rje'i tshig mngon du gyur pa ni/ rgyud gzhan du bcom ldan 'das kyis bzhi pa'i lam bla ma'i kha la ltos nas gsal bar ma bstan par sbas pa las/

'dir 'jig rten kun rdzob kyi rdo rje'i tshig mngon spyod sogs thun mong dang / yid ches pa'i mtshan ma can bzhi pa'i lam phyag chen sgom pa gsal bar bstan pa ste/ dang po'i sangs rgyas 'di la rdo rje'i tshig de dag nyid rab tu gsal bar bstan pa dang bshad pa dang rab tu bshad pa dag gis bcom ldan 'das kyis gsal bar mdzad do/ /zhes dang / rdo rje'i tshig la sogs pa mtshan ma sngon du 'gro ba can 'di dag rab tu gsal bar rgyud kyi rgyal po mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas las bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs so/ /de'i phyir rgyud ni rgyud gzhan tshol ba rnams las rgyud kyi rgyal po thams cad kyi rdo rje'i tshig mngon du gyur pa'o/ /zhes so/ sangs rgyas rin chen za ma tog kha 'byed pa ni/ mi 'gyur ba bde ba lhan cig skyes sku'i rten nam gnas bde stong gsal bar byed pa ste/ sangs rgyas rin chen ni mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba yin la/ za ma tog ni rdo rje dang pad+ma ste sangs rgyas rin chen za ma tog go /de nyid rgyud kyi rgyal po gang gis kha 'byed pa de ni sangs rgyas rin chen za ma tog kha 'byed pa'o/ /zhes so/ /'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bden pa la brten pa ni/ 'jig rten pa'i bden pa 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub sgrub byed bskyed rim mam/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bden pa phyag chen gyi dngos grub sgrub byed mi rtog pa'i sems rdzogs rim gnyis ka ston pa ste/ 'jig rten pa'i bden pa ni dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rnam par rtog pa'i sgom pa bskyed pa'i rim pas 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub sgrub par byed pa'o/ /'jig rten las 'das pa'i bden pa ni du ba la sogs pa'i mtshan ma dang / rnam par mi rtog pa'i sems rdzogs pa'i rim pas phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub sgrub par byed pa'o/ /zhes dang / bden pa 'di dag la brten pa ni 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bden pa la brten pa ste lam gnyis ka bstan pa'i phyir ro/

/zhes so/ /mngon par byang chub pa bzhi dang rdo rje bzhi yongs su dag pa ni mi 'gyur ba'i skad cig nyi khri chig stong drug brgya rdzogs pa'i skad cig gcig gis byang chub pa ye shes rdo rje ste/ ye shes rnam pa lngas byang chub pa thugs rdo rje/ phung khams kyi rlung bcu dang / dbang yul gyi khams bcu'am/ dbang lnga phung lnga las dbang lnga bya ba lnga'am/ phung khams dbang yul lnga sgrib bral du gyur pa'i rnam pa nyi shus byang chub pa gsung rdo rje/ mtha' yas pa'i sprul pa sgyu ma lta bu'i dra bas byang chub pa sku rdo rje ste/ bzhi po 'di rnams kyis yongs su dag par byed pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyis blo bur dri ma dag par byed pa ste/ skad cig gcig gis mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa dang / rnam pa lngas mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa dang / rnam pa nyi shus mngon par rdzogs par byang chub dang / sgyu 'phrul dra bas mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa ste 'di rnams kyis yongs su dag pa ni mngal skyes bskyed pa'i rim pa dang du ba la sogs pa sku rdzogs pa'i rim pas so/ /zhes so/ /sku bzhi dang zhes pa'i 'bras bu'i sku bzhi sgrib bral gyi dag pa lhan skyes sogs bzhi dang / rgyu mngal skyes kyi sku bzhi gnas skabs bzhi'i mtshan nyid can blo bur dri bcas te/ sku bzhi ni dga' ba dang / chos dang / longs spyod rdzogs pa dang / sprul pa rnams mngal skyes kyi bzhi pa dang / shin tu gnyid log pa dang / rmi lam dang / sad pa'i mtshan nyid kyi gnas skabs can te/ de dag kyang sangs rgyas rnams kyi sgrib pa dang bral ba'o/ /zhes so/ /rigs drug ni/ steng 'og gi rtsa chen drug la srog rtsol gyi rlung rtag tu rgyu ba ye shes kyi phung po mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba bskyed byed ye shes kyi khams/ yul rnam par rig byed dbang po drug dang / rnam shes drug gi bdag nyid rnam shes kyi phung po nam mkha'i khams/

dbang drug yul drug la 'jug par byed pa'i 'du byed kyi phung po rlung / nyams su myong bya gzugs sogs kyi khams drug las skyes pa'i tshor phung ni me/ mgrin rkan spyi bo mchu so rna ste tha snyad drug gis dngos po med kyi don gsal bar byed pa'i 'du shes kyi phung po chu/ sa chu me rlung khu khrag ste khams drug gi bdag nyid gzugs phung ni sa ste/ rigs drug ni mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba ye shes kyi khams dang / rnam par shes pa nam mkha'i khams dang / 'du byed rlung gi khams dang / tshor ba me'i khams dang / 'du shes chu'i khams dang / gzugs sa'i khams dang / mngal skyes rnams kyi rigs drug sgrib pa dang bcas pa yin la/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi sgrib pa dang bral ba'o/ /zhes so/ /bden pa bcu gnyis ni/ kun nyon dang rnam byang rten 'brel gyi mtshan nyid can kun rdzob la 'pho ba bcu gnyis kyi rlung rgyu ba 'gags pa ste/ bden pa bcu gnyis ni/ ma rig pa dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa dang / ming dang gzugs dang / skye mched drug dang / reg pa dang / tshor ba dang / sred pa dang / len pa dang / srid pa dang / skye ba dang / rga shi ste mngal skyes rnams kyis bden pa bcu gnyis ni sgrib pa dang bcas pa yin la/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi sgrib pa dang bral ba'o/ /'pho ba bcu gnyis kyi srog gi dbye bas srog gi rlung rgyu ba'i phyir mngal nas skyes pa rnams kyi sgrib pa dang bcas pa'o/ /yan lag bcu gnyis 'gags pa'i phyir sangs rgyas rnams kyi ni sgrib pa dang bral ba'o/ /zhes so/ /de kho na nyid bcu drug ni/ don dam pa'i de kho na nyid 'gyur med bde ba bskyed byed dga' ba bcu drug ste/ de kho na nyid bcu drug ni/ sprul pa'i sku dang / sprul pa'i gsung dang / sprul pa'i thugs dang / sprul pa'i ye shes dang / longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang / longs spyod rdzogs pa'i gsung dang /

longs spyod rdzogs pa'i thugs dang / longs spyod rdzogs pa'i ye shes dang / chos kyi sku dang / chos kyi gsung dang / chos kyi thugs dang / chos kyi ye shes dang / lhan cig skyes pa'i sku dang / lhan cig skyes pa'i gsung dang / lhan cig skyes pa'i thugs dang / lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes te dga' ba dang / mchog dga' dang / khyad par gyi dga' ba dang / lhan cig skyes pa'i dbye bas de kho na nyid bcu drug mngal skyes rnams kyi ni sgrib pa dang bcas pa yin te/ bcu drug phyed phyed thig le 'dor ba'i phyir ro/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi ni sgrib pa dang bral ba yin te/ bcu drug phyed phyed thig le 'dzin pa nyid kyi phyir ro/ /zhes so/ /stong pa nyid bcu drug ni/ phyir nag phyogs dang nyi ma/ nang du rdul dang shes rab ste/ stong pa/ chen po/ don dam stong pa nyid do/ /dang po ni nang du lus rtsa dag pas phung lnga'i sgrib pa dang bral ba/ phyir nag po'i tshes gcig la sogs pa lnga/ gnyis pa ni/ ngag rlung dag pas khams lnga sgrib pa dang bral ba/ tshes drug la sogs pa lnga/ gsum pa ni sems kyi gzung 'dzin dag pas dbang lnga sgrib pa dang bral ba dang / tshes bcu gcig la sogs pa lnga/ bcu drug pa rnam kun mchog gi stong pa nyid ni dmigs bcas pra phab pa lta bu dang / gnam stong gi mtha' dang dkar po'i tshes gcig gis dbus kyi cha ste stong pa nyid bcu drug ces pa ni/ nag po'i phyogs dang nyi ma dang shes rab bo/ /zhes dang / stong pa nyid la dbye ba gsum ste/ stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid do/ /de la stong pa nyid ni phung po lnga stong pa nyid de/ nag po'i tshes gcig la sogs pa tshes lnga'o/ /chen po stong pa nyid ni khams lnga stong pa nyid de/ drug pa la sogs pa tshes lnga'o/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid ni dbang po lnga stong pa nyid bcu gcig pa la sogs pa tshes lnga'o/

/des na gnam stong gi mthar thug pa tshes bco lnga ni stong pa nyid bco lnga'o/ /gnam stong gi mtha' dang dkar po'i tshes gcig gi dang po'i dbus su bcu drug pa rnam pa thams cad stong pa nyid do/ /zhes so/ /snying rje bcu drug ni/ phyir dkar phyogs dang zla ba/ nang du zhu ba dang thabs dang / sems can las phyag chos/ ye shes/ dmigs med phyag chen la dmigs pa'i theg le/ 'jag g.yo/ mi 'gyur ba'i snying rje gsum/ phyir dkar po'i tshes gcig nas bco lnga'i bar lnga lnga/ bcu drug pa ye shes kyi lhan cig skyes dga' ste/ snying rje bcu drug ces pa ni/ dkar po'i phyogs dang zla ba dang thabs so/ /zhes dang / de bzhin du snying rje rnam pa gsum ste/ sems can la dmigs pa dang / chos la dmigs pa dang / dmigs pa med pa'o/ /de la sems can la dmigs pa ni dkar po'i tshes gcig la sogs pa tshes lnga'o/ /chos la dmigs pa ni/ drug pa la sogs pa tshes lnga'o/ /dmigs pa med pa ni bcu gcig pa la sogs pa tshes lnga ste nya'i mthar thug pa'o/ /nya'i mtha' dang nag po'i tshes gcig 'jug pa'i dang po'i dbus su snying rje bcu drug pa'o/ /'di dag brjod pa'i phyir/ 'di dag gcig pa nyid ni stong pa nyid bcu drug dang / snying rje bcu drug gi bdag nyid brjod par bya ba ste/ de'i brjod par byed pa'o/ /zhes so/ /dbang bskur ba 'jig rten pa'i bcu ni/ chu/ cod pan/ dar dpyang / rdor dril/ brtul zhugs/ ming / rjes gnang ste bdun las dang po gnyis kyis lus/ de nas gnyis kyis ngag de nas gnyis kyi sems/ tha mas ye shes dang / bum pas khams/ cod pan gyis phung po/ brtul zhugs kyis skye mched/ ming gis las dbang / dar dpyang gis rlung / rdor dril gyis rtsa dag pa dang / rnal 'byor pa'i kun rdzob kyi dbang bum gsang shes rab ye shes kyis sgo gsum dag par byed pa dang / 'das pa'i dbang thig le bzhi 'khor lo bzhir 'gog pas blo bur dri ma 'gog pa ste/

re shig 'jig rten pa ni/ chu dang / cod pan dang / dar dpyang dang / rdo rje dril bu dang / rtul zhugs chen po dang / ming dang / rjes su gnang ba dang / bum pa dang / gsang ba dang / shes rab ye shes te/ mngal nas skyes pa rnams kyi 'jig rten kun rdzob kyi dbang bcu ni lus dang ngag dang sems dang ye shes dang khams dang phung po dang skye mched dang las kyi dbang po la sogs pa yongs su dag pa bya ba'o/ /'jig rten las 'das pa bcu gcig pa ni/ bzhi pa de yang de bzhin no zhes pa'i nges pas phyag rgya chen po mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i ye shes kyi mtshan nyid bla ma'i zhal la lus dang ngag la sogs pa sgrib pa med pa nyid kyis sbyong bar byed pa'o/ /zhes so/ /las dang / ye shes dang / phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub ces pa la las phyag ni phyi'i bud med de'i dngos grub 'dzag bde/ ye phyag rtog pas brtags pa bskyed pa'i lha mo/ de'i dngos grub g.yo ba'i bde ba/ phyag chen stong gzugs kyi rig ma/ de'i dngos grub phyag chen mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba ste/ las kyi phyag rgya ni nu ma dang skrar ldan pa'o/ /ye shes kyi phyag rgya ni rang gi sems kyis yongs su brtags pa'o/ /phyag rgya chen mo ni rnam par rtogs dang bral ba pra phab pa'i rang bzhin can no/ /'di rnams kyi dngos grub ni rnam pa gsum ste/ 'dod pa na spyod pa ni las kyi phyag rgya'i dngos grub bo/ /gzugs kyi srid pa'i dngos po'i mtshan nyid ni ye shes kyi phyag rgya'i dngos grub bo/ /dngos po dang dngos po med pa dang bral ba rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang ldan pa ni phyag rgya chen mo'i dngos grub bo/ /zhes so/ /sku bzhi nas 'das pa'i dngos grub kyi bar gsal bar ston pas de skad ces bya ste/ sku bzhi la sogs pa 'di dag gi 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam rab tu gsal bar byed pa ni mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas so/

/zhes so/ /de ltar brjod pa'i rim pas phyi'i 'jig rten/ nang rdo rje'i lus/ de dngos grub kyi snod du byed pa dbang / snod du gyur nas de kho na nyid rnam pa gnyis kyi sgrub thabs las kun rdzob kyi de kho na gtso bor ston pa sgrub thabs/ don dam pa'i de kho na nyid gtso bor ston pa ye shes te le'u lnga 'am/ yang dag pa'i rtog pas brtags pa'i brtag pa lnga'i bdag nyid/ dgos pa sems can mtha' dag gis dngos dang brgyud pas sangs rgyas 'thob pa'i don du bstan pa'i rgyud mtshan dus kyi 'khor lo de las rnal 'byor pas nyams su blang bya'i rdo rje'i rnal 'byor ni don dam bden pa rgyu rnam kun mchog gi stong pa sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba dang / 'bras bu 'gyur med bde ba ro gcig pa'i ting nge 'dzin te/ gang don dam pa'i bden pas bstan pa de ni 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub sgrub pa'i slad du rang gi sems kyis yongs su brtags pa'i chos dang bral ba/ gzhon nu ma rnams kyis me long la sogs pa la pra phab pa bzhin du/ rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis rang gi sems kyi 'od gsal mngon sum du nam mkha' la snang ba 'dod pa'i don gyi 'bras bu gter ba ste/ 'bras bu ni 'gyur ba med pa'i bde ba'i ye shes kyi sems so/ /sems 'di gnyis gcig pa nyid ni shes rab dang thabs kyi bdag nyid rdo rje'i rnal 'byor don chen po mchog tu mi 'gyur ba dang po'i sangs rgyas rigs med pa dus kyi 'khor lo bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpar rgyud gzhan thams cad du rab tu grags so/ /zhes so/ /de nyid la phar phyin du ngo bo nyid sku/ sngags su lhan cig skyes sku zhes gsungs la/ de phyogs 'dzin thams cad dang bral ba'o/ /rang bzhin med pa'i phyir te/ sems kyi skad cig gcig dang du ma dang bral ba'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir/

de ltar/ de'i phyir rang bzhin med pa'i phyogs ni bcom ldan 'das kyis phyogs med par gsungs so/ /phyogs zhes bya ba ni dngos po dang dngos po med pa dang / yod pa dang med pa dang / yin pa dang min pa dang / gcig dang gcig ma yin pa dang / rtag pa dang chad pa dang / srid pa dang mya ngan las 'das pa dang / gzugs dang gzugs ma yin pa dang / sgra dang sgra ma yin pa dang / skad cig dang / skad cig ma yin pa dang / chags pa dang chags pa ma yin pa dang / zhe sdang dang zhe sdang ma yin pa dang / gti mug dang gti mug ma yin pa zhes pa de lta bu la sogs pa rnams ni phyogs te/ phan tshun ltos pa dang bcas pa nyid kyi phyir ro/ /phyogs 'di dang bral ba ni sangs rgyas rnams kyi mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa rang bzhin med pa ste/ skad cig gcig dang du ma dang bral ba'i ye shes ni rgyal ba rnams kyis de kho na nyid ces gsungs so/ /zhes so/ /des na de gzugs min te/ rdul phran med pa'i phyir/ gzugs med pa min te/ mig shes la snang ba'i phyir te/ stong pa nyid dang snying rje'i bdag nyid kyi gzugs rnam par dag pa'i sems gzhon nu ma'i pra phab pa lta bu ni gzugs kyi mtshan nyid ma yin te/ rdul phra rab med pa'i phyir ro/ /gzugs med pa'i mtshan nyid ma yin te stong pa la yod pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes so/ /des na kun rdzob kyi chos rang gi ngo bos stong par snang ba dang / stong nyid chos can kun rdzob kyi gzugs su snang ba can yin pas yod med 'gal ba'i chos can du gnas pas 'jig rten pa'i dpe las 'das te/ de'i phyir kun rdzob stong pa nyid kyi gzugs can dang stong pa nyid kun rdzob kyi gzugs can te 'jig rten pa'i dpe las 'das pa nyid kyi phyir/ sems gang yod pa'i sems de ni sems med pa/ rtag pa dang chad pa'i chos kyi mtshan nyid dang bral ba/ stong pa nyid dang snying rje dbyer med pa'o/ /don dam pa'i bden pas gnyis ka'i sems dag chos mi mthun pa'i phyir yod pa dang med pa las 'das pa/

dngos po dang dngos po med pa zad pa rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gnyis su med pa ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung rigs med pa nyid kyi phyir ro/ /zhes so/ /des na dngos po dngos med gcig pa srid na 'di'i dper 'gyur te/ chos mi mthun pa'i phyir/ de yang yod pa ni med pa min bum pa bzhin/ nam mkha'i me tog thams cad du med do/ /de bzhin du rnam pa thams cad du med pa ni yod par mi 'gyur/ nam mkha'i me tog bzhin/ bum pa ni rnam pa thams cad du yod do/ /de dag ltar rgyun chad pa ni dngos por mi 'gyur/ lhag med kyi myang 'das bzhin/ 'khor ba la ni rgyun yod do/ /rgyun yod pa ni chad par mi 'gyur/ srid pa bzhin/ lhag med la ni rgyun med do/ /des na bum pa dang nam mkha'i me tog gcig na 'di'i dper 'gyur te/ dper na 'jig rten pa'i dpe bum pa dang chos mi mthun pa'i phyir nam mkha'i me tog ni med pa thams cad kyis med do/ /de bzhin du nam mkha'i me tog dang chos mi mthun pa'i phyir bum pa ni dngos po thams cad kyis yod do/ /zhes 'di gnyis phan tshun chos mi mthun pa'i phyir dper 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du chad pa dang chos mi mthun pa'i phyir srid pa ni dngos po thams cad kyis yod do/ /srid pa dang chos mi mthun pa'i phyir/ chad pa ni med pa thams cad kyis med do/ /chad pa'i sgras ni mya ngan las 'das pa dngos po med pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /de bzhin du 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dper bum pa dang nam mkha'i me tog 'di gnyis gcig pa nyid 'gyur te chos mi mthun pa'i phyir ro/ /bum pa dang nam mkha'i me tog 'di dag 'jig rten pa'i kun rdzob tu gcig pa nyid med de/ phan tshun 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes so/ /rnal 'byor de nyid kyis mi'i skye ba 'di nyid la sangs rgyas su 'khrid par byed de/ de bzhin du rgyud gzhan dag tu yang de bzhin gshegs pas rdo rje'i rnal 'byor phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub gter bar byed pa po gsungs so/

/zhes dang / 'dir nam mkha'i khams la rnam par rtog pa med pa'i sems dang / du ba la sogs pa'i mtshan mas phyag rgya chen po rnam pa kun sna tshogs pa'i ngo bo nyid kyis sgom pa mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba'i sgrub thabs dang / bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs dag gis mi rnams kyis skye ba 'di la sangs rgyas nyid dang rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid de/ dgos pa dang dgos pa'i dgos pa bsdus pa'o/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa man ngag dngos ngo sprad pa ni/ 'dus pa'i rgyud phyi mar/ rnam pa rang bzhin rgyu yin te/ /de bzhin mi 'phrogs 'bras bu 'o/ /gzhi ni thabs zhes bya ba ste/ /gsum gyis rgyud kyi don bsdus pa'o/ /zhes pa ltar rgyud kyi brjod bya thams cad gsum du 'dus pas rgyud gsum gyi sgo nas ngo sprod pa la/ gang 'khrid pa ni rgyu rgyud de/ sems can rnams kyi sems kun gzhi'i rnam shes kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba yin yang sgrib pa dang bcas pa ni 'khor ba zhes bya la/ sgrib pa'i gtso bo yang 'pho ba'i bag chags te/ 'khor ba 'di ni rang gi sems kyi bag chags tsam ste/ gzhan 'ga' yang ma yin no/ /'khor ba'i bag chags kyang 'pho ba'i mtshan nyid kyi skad cig yin gyi mi 'gyur ba ma yin no/ /zhes so/ /de nyid bdud ces kyang bya la/ de dang bral ba ni sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal dang sangs rgyas zhes bya ste/ de'i phyir bdud ces bya ba ni sems can rnams kyi 'khor ba'i sems kyi bag chags kyi dri ma'o/ /sangs rgyas nyid ces bya ba ni/ 'khor ba'i bag chags dang bral ba'i sems so/ /de ltar yang bcom ldan 'das kyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las/ sems gang zhig yod pa'i sems de ni sems ma yin zhes rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal bar gsungs te/ de nyid ni 'khor ba'i bag chags dang bral ba'o/ /de'i phyir bdud ni dri ma dang bcas pa'i sems yin la/ sangs rgyas nyid ni dri ma med pa'i sems so/

/zhes dang / mi'am ci'i rgyal pos zhus pa'i mdo las/ gang dag pa de dri ma med pa'o/ /gang dri ma med pa de 'od gsal ba'o/ /gang 'od gsal ba de sems kyi rang bzhin no/ /zhes dang / sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas yin te sangs rgyas chen po gzhan 'dir 'jig rten khams na yod ma yin/ de rnams mnyes par byas pas dpag med srid pa gcod par byed/ de rnam par mi rtog pa las so/ /zhes dang / kyai rdo rjer/ sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas nyid/ /'on kyang blo bur dri mas bsgribs/ /de nyid bsal na sangs rgyas nyid/ /ces dang / gur las/ rin chen sems las phyir gyur pa'i/ /sangs rgyas med cing sems can med/ /rnam pa'i don dang rnam shes dag /phyi rol gyur pa 'ga' yang med/ /ces dang / kyai rdo rjer/ 'jig rten khams ni gang du yang / /sangs rgyas gzhan du rnyed mi 'gyur/ /sems nyid rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid/ /sangs rgyas gzhan du bstan pa med/ /ces dang / 'di nyid 'khor ba zhes bya ste/ /'di nyid mya ngan 'das pa nyid/ /rmongs phyir 'khor ba'i gzugs can te/ /rmongs med 'khor ba dag pa nyid/ /ces dang / rtse mor/ 'khor ba'i don ni ci zhig lags/ /ji ltar byis pa rnams 'byung zhing / /yang dang yang du 'khor byed de/ /de yang 'khor ba'o dag pa'i bdag /nga nyid yin te rang nyid gtso/ /mya ngan 'das pa'ang ci zhig brjod/ /ces so/ /de nyid thog ma med pa nas rgyun chags pas rgyud do/ /de bzhin 'od gsal ba yin na gang gis 'khor snyam na/ sems can rnams thog med pa'i 'khrul pa'i bag chags kyis rang bzhin de nyid la chos sna tshogs su brtags nas de nyid bden par zhen pas 'khor te/ dpal snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i khye'u'i mdo sder yang gsungs pa/ khye'us gsol pa/ sems can 'di ni dmigs min na/ /thub khyod sems can su zhig skyob/ /ci ste chos te gzigs med na/ /su yi nyon mongs skye bar 'gyur/

/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ ngag 'di nyid ni de bzhin te/ /sems ni rtag tu 'od gsal ba'o/ /sems can blo bur nyon mongs pa/ /dam pa min pas rtag nyon mongs/ /khye'us gsol pa/ phyi 'am nang ni gang zhig tu'ang / /nyon mongs rnams ni dmigs min na/ /de rnams blo bur ji ltar lags/ /bdag gi zhu ba 'dir gsung gsol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ ji ltar bar snang sprin rnams ni/ /mthong yang de rnams de bzhin med/ /de ltar nyon mongs skye ba ni/ /mthong ste de yang de bzhin med/ /khye'us gsol pa/ log pa'i chos de gang gnas pa/ /de la de ni chos nyid na/ /'o na de lta mtshan nyid chos/ /log pa dmigs par mi 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sngon gyi mtha' dang phyi ma'i mtha'/ /de bzhin da lta byung ba nyid/ /skad cig gcig gis rtogs nas nga / /mnyam pa nyid ni ston par byed/ /khye'us gsol pa/ chos rnams yi ge med pa ni/ /thub pa ston par rigs ma yin/ /chos med pa la chos gsung ba/ /khyod kyis 'jig rten bslu bar mdzad/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ nga ni 'jig rten bslu ba min/ /chos min smra ba nga ma yin/ /phyin ci log gyur sems can gyi/ /nyon mongs nga ni sel bar byed/ /dam pa ma yin 'du shes ldan/ /byis pa log par brtags zhes bya/ /don de khong du chud don du/ /'dren pa rnams ni 'byung bar byed/ /ces dang / las kyi sgrib pa rnam par dag pa'i mdor/ dge slong de ltar chos thams cad ni de ltar 'od gsal ba yin na yang byis pa so so'i skye bo rnams ni yang dag pa ma yin pa'i chos la brtags/ phyin ci log la brtags/ gso ba dang / gsog lta bu'i chos thams cad la brtags pas sems can dmyal ba dang dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten du 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / sems kun nas nyon mongs pas sems can rnams kun nas nyon mongs pa can du 'gyur zhing /
